page_title: NIC 2-0 LEN | Nice v Lens 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
90+1' Substitution. Jeremie Boga (Nice) on for Gaetan Laborde.
90+1' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Ali Abdi (Nice) replaces Dante.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Mohamed Abdelmonem (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Hicham Boudaoui.
88' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) sees a yellow card from Romain Lissorgue after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
88' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
86' The resulting set piece from Lens is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Will Still prepares a substitution. Andy Diouf is replaced by Hamzat Ojediran (Lens).
82' M'Bala Nzola will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
82' Andy Diouf (Lens) makes a strong challenge and Romain Lissorgue blows for a foul.
79' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
79' Nice are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Melvin Bard (Nice) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
75' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Clauss will be replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
72' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Romain Lissorgue signals.
71' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Sofiane Diop (Nice) coming on for Mohamed-Ali Cho.
67' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
67' Nice are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' 2 - 0 Goal! Jonathan Clauss (Nice) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net.
64' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
63' The current number of shots on goal is 6:1.
60' Dante (Nice) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Herve Koffi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
58' Nice are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' Facundo Medina (Lens) is told to leave the pitch by the referee after receiving a yellow card for misconduct!
54' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) causes Marcin Bulka little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
50' Malang Sarr (Lens) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Romain Lissorgue blows his whistle for a foul. Nice are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
49' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Adrien Thomasson will not participate anymore and Anass Zaroury (Lens) is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Goduine Koyalipou is replaced by Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' The game is interrupted. M'Bala Nzola (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Nice have a free kick.
45+1' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
43' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
42' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
40' Lens show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' It looks like Adrien Thomasson (Lens) saw red with that tackle. Romain Lissorgue won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Nice earn a free kick.
35' The game is interrupted now, Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
32' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
31' Today's referee Romain Lissorgue rightly decides to book Facundo Medina (Lens) for his harsh tackle.
30' Nice keep hold of the ball with numerous one-two passes, but one error and they surrender possession. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.

27' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Herve Koffi is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
24' CHANCE! Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
24' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

21' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of M'Bala Nzola (Lens), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
18' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' Lens are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

16' A neat pass is well received by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nice comes to nothing.

14' Nice slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Herve Koffi no chance!
9' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Adrien Thomasson (Lens). PENALTY! One of the players from Nice is about to take a penalty kick. Let's see how this ends.
7' Romain Lissorgue shows the yellow card to Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) for a heavy challenge.
7' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Nice players look gutted.
7' Wait! Referee Romain Lissorgue has indicated he is going to review the Nice goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
5' Evann Guessand (Nice) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.

3' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lens are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nice will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Romain Lissorgue.
